# 1636. Sort Array by Increasing Frequency

## Solution 1 (time O(nlogn), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def frequencySort(self, nums):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :rtype: List[int]
        """
        cnt = collections.Counter(nums)
        nums.sort(key=lambda x: (cnt[x], -x))
        return nums
```
